scenario.title: Carrier rejects shipment notices
scenario.initial_request: Let an AI agent auto-fix rejected shipment notices and resubmit them

M-LOC-UNKNOWN-SHARE.name: Share of sampled carrier rejects with reason LOC_UNKNOWN
M-LOC-UNKNOWN-SHARE.denominator: total sampled reject records in DA-REJ

M-RESUBMIT-SUCCESS-RATE.name: Reason-specific resubmission success rate after fix
M-RESUBMIT-SUCCESS-RATE.numerator: notices accepted by carrier after reason-specific correction and resubmission

F-01.statement: reject-log returned 3 reject records: 2 with reason LOC_UNKNOWN, 1 with reason EVENT_ORDER.

F-02.statement: The reject-log query sample size for this report was 3 records.

CL-01.statement: Let an AI agent auto-fix rejected shipment notices and resubmit them

CL-02.statement: The carrier system is flaky; just resubmit everything.

H-FIXABLE-NOTICE-ERRORS.statement: Shipment notices sent via H-1 contain correctable data/format errors that cause carrier rejects, so an AI agent could auto-fix and resubmit them to resolve the issue, as implied by SH-REQ's request.

H-BUSINESS-RULE-REJECTS.statement: DA-REJ is explicitly described as tracking 'carrier business rejects' (per tool_surface), suggesting rejections stem from carrier business rules (e.g., capacity, contract, eligibility) rather than fixable notice content, making auto-fix+resubmit ineffective.

H-NO-FEEDBACK-LOOP.statement: There is no handoff returning carrier reject information (DA-REJ) from ORG-B back to ORG-A, so the shipper may lack the data needed to even know why notices were rejected, making the root cause a missing feedback/process gap rather than a content-fixing problem.

H-UNVERIFIED-REJECT-SCOPE.statement: DA-REJ's completeness is marked UNKNOWN, so the actual pattern, frequency, and cause of rejects behind SH-REQ's request have not been established, meaning any root-cause claim (including auto-fixable errors) is currently unverified.

H-REASON-SPECIFIC-FIXES.statement: Rejects stem from at least two distinct reasons (LOC_UNKNOWN and EVENT_ORDER) that likely require different remediation logic, so a single generic AI auto-fix routine may not uniformly resolve all reject causes.

H-CARRIER-FLAKY-TRANSIENT.statement: Carrier-side rejects are caused by transient system/infrastructure flakiness rather than content errors or business rules, so plain resubmission (without content fixing) would resolve them.

H-FIXABLE-NOTICE-ERRORS-INDEPE.statement: Carrier rejects stem from at least two distinct content/format defect types (LOC_UNKNOWN, EVENT_ORDER) that require different remediation logic, independent of whether an AI agent performs the fix.

interpretation_history.interpretation: The reject-log sample (3 records) shows reject reasons of LOC_UNKNOWN (2/3) and EVENT_ORDER (1/3) — data/content-type issues, not carrier business-rule categories like capacity, contract or eligibility. This points the root cause toward notice content/format problems rather than business ineligibility, but the sample is small (3 records) relative to DA-REJ's overall UNKNOWN completeness.

E-02.content: The carrier system is flaky; just resubmit everything.

interpretation_history.interpretation: SH-REQ (the requester, non-authoritative) attributes rejects to a "flaky" carrier system and proposes blind resubmission rather than content fixing. This is an unverified stakeholder claim that offers an alternative cause narrative to the content/format-error reasons seen in E-01 (LOC_UNKNOWN, EVENT_ORDER).

U-POPULATION-SCOPE.question: What is the true frequency/distribution of each reject reason across the full population of shipment notices, given DA-REJ completeness is UNKNOWN?
U-POPULATION-SCOPE.decision_impact: Determines whether a reason-specific fix would address most rejects or only a small, unrepresentative subset.
U-POPULATION-SCOPE.resolution_path: Query reject-log for the full history and confirm/establish DA-REJ completeness before scaling any fix.
U-POPULATION-SCOPE.safe_placeholder: Limit any remediation design to the 3 confirmed cases until population scope is confirmed.

U-CARRIER-INFRA-FLAKINESS.question: Does the carrier also reject notices due to transient system/infrastructure issues independent of content errors, as SH-REQ claims (E-02)?
U-CARRIER-INFRA-FLAKINESS.decision_impact: If true, some rejects could resolve via plain resubmission, changing the remediation logic design.
U-CARRIER-INFRA-FLAKINESS.resolution_path: Obtain carrier-side incident/uptime data from ORG-B (SH-INT) correlated with reject timestamps.
U-CARRIER-INFRA-FLAKINESS.safe_placeholder: Treat each sampled reject reason as content-based until carrier infra data is reviewed.

U-FEEDBACK-LOOP-GAP.question: Does ORG-A receive the carrier's reject reason data (DA-REJ) back through any handoff, or is there no feedback loop at all?
U-FEEDBACK-LOOP-GAP.decision_impact: If no feedback loop exists, part of the operational gap may be a missing reject-notification handoff rather than only notice content errors.
U-FEEDBACK-LOOP-GAP.resolution_path: Check for an existing or planned handoff carrying DA-REJ from ORG-B to ORG-A; interview SH-INT.
U-FEEDBACK-LOOP-GAP.safe_placeholder: Route current reject-log findings manually to ORG-A operations until an automated feedback handoff is confirmed.

U-METRIC-VALIDITY.question: Is the LOC_UNKNOWN/EVENT_ORDER proportion (2/3, 1/3) a valid baseline given n=3?
U-METRIC-VALIDITY.decision_impact: Affects whether reject-rate-by-reason can be used as a reliable baseline/target for success criteria.
U-METRIC-VALIDITY.resolution_path: Re-run the distribution analysis against the full reject-log population once completeness is established.
U-METRIC-VALIDITY.safe_placeholder: Report current proportions as a preliminary sample-based observation, not a committed baseline.

A-SAMPLE-REPRESENTATIVE.statement: The 3-record reject-log sample reflects the overall distribution of carrier reject reasons, even though DA-REJ completeness is marked UNKNOWN.

A-REASONS-ARE-CONTENT-ERRORS.statement: LOC_UNKNOWN and EVENT_ORDER reject reasons reflect correctable notice content/format errors rather than carrier-side processing issues outside the notice itself.

A-NOTICES-DISTINCT.statement: The three sampled reject records (N-1, N-2, N-3) represent three distinct shipment notices, not repeated retries of the same notice.

SC-REASON-SPECIFIC-LOGIC.statement: Any remediation approach must apply correction logic specific to each distinct reject reason rather than a single uniform resubmission.
SC-REASON-SPECIFIC-LOGIC.threshold: covers all reason codes observed in DA-REJ
SC-REASON-SPECIFIC-LOGIC.validation_method: Review remediation mapping against distinct reason codes present in reject-log output.

SC-POPULATION-CONFIRMED.statement: The full-population reject reason distribution must be confirmed before any fix is scaled beyond the sampled cases.
SC-POPULATION-CONFIRMED.validation_method: Query reject-log for full history and confirm completeness attribute is resolved.

SC-RESUBMISSION-SUCCESS-TARGET.statement: Reason-specific fixes should raise the resubmission acceptance rate for previously rejected notices.
SC-RESUBMISSION-SUCCESS-TARGET.validation_method: Track resubmit_success_rate over a post-deployment window via reject-log and resubmission records.

problem_definition.requested_solution: Let an AI agent auto-fix rejected shipment notices and resubmit them (SH-REQ, CL-01).
symptoms: Shipment notices sent via H-1 are rejected by the carrier (ORG-B) and logged in DA-REJ.
Sampled reject-log records (n=3) show two distinct reject reasons: LOC_UNKNOWN (2/3) and EVENT_ORDER (1/3) (F-01).
problem_definition.root_problem: Shipment notices sent from ORG-A to ORG-B via handoff H-1 are being rejected by the carrier for distinct content/format defects — predominantly LOC_UNKNOWN (2/3 sampled) and EVENT_ORDER (1/3) — rather than business-rule ineligibility (E-01, F-01). Because these reject reasons differ in kind, a single uniform remediation step cannot resolve them all; each requires reason-specific correction before resubmission (H-REASON-SPECIFIC-FIXES).

DEFINE gate result was CONDITIONAL_PASS (seq 56), deferring U-POPULATION-SCOPE and U-FEEDBACK-LOOP-GAP as verification obligations rather than resolving them.
Released scope (SD-1 release_scope) is limited to query_reject_log and analyze_reject_reason_distribution against DA-REJ; the minimum useful scope is the distribution analysis itself.

Decision: RELEASE_WITH_KNOWN_LIMITATION, hold list empty — the three open VOBs (VOB-U-POPULATION-SCOPE, VOB-U-FEEDBACK-LOOP-GAP, VOB-R-3) all have blocking_scope (map_reject_reason_to_remediation:H-1, verify_reject_log_completeness:DA-REJ) that falls outside the actually released scope.

Four remediation ideas (SR-FULL-POPULATION-REJECT-VERIF, SR-ESTABLISH-REJECT-FEEDBACK-HA, SR-UPSTREAM-LOC-VALIDATION-CONF, SR-EVENT-ORDER-SEQUENCING-VALID) were identified but left unfinished/not implemented in this release.
limitations_explained: DEFINE gate was only CONDITIONAL_PASS; the deferred critical unknowns are tracked as VOBs rather than closed.
VOB-U-POPULATION-SCOPE is open: the true full-population reject-reason distribution is unknown because DA-REJ completeness is UNKNOWN, so this analysis is based on a 3-record sample only.

VOB-U-FEEDBACK-LOOP-GAP is open and H-NO-FEEDBACK-LOOP (CANDIDATE) indicates no ongoing handoff returns DA-REJ data from ORG-B to ORG-A, so future rejects cannot be detected automatically beyond this one-time query.
VOB-R-3 is open: it is unverified whether process P-1 has a documented owner/system able to implement upstream validation changes for LOC_UNKNOWN/EVENT_ORDER.
The reject-reason split (2/3 LOC_UNKNOWN, 1/3 EVENT_ORDER) rests on sample size n=3 (F-02), which U-METRIC-VALIDITY (OPEN) flags as too small to confirm the population-wide pattern.
Upstream fixes — a location-code validation step and an event-sequencing validation rule in ORG-A's notice-generation process (both targeting H-1) — were identified but not built in this release.

SH-REQ's alternative claim that carrier-side transient infrastructure flakiness (E-02) causes rejects remains unverified (U-CARRIER-INFRA-FLAKINESS, OPEN); H-CARRIER-FLAKY-TRANSIENT is still only a CANDIDATE hypothesis, not confirmed or ruled out.
